settings.max_label_chars.label: Maximum label characters
settings.max_label_chars.description: Truncate workspace names to this many characters. Use 0 to show full names.
settings.hide_inactive.label: Hide inactive workspaces
settings.hide_inactive.description: Show only special workspaces that are currently visible on a monitor.
settings.pill_radius.label: Pill corner radius
settings.pill_radius.description: Set the chip corner radius in logical pixels, from 0 to 80.
settings.secondary_inactive.label: Fill inactive workspaces
settings.secondary_inactive.description: Use the secondary palette color instead of a transparent background for inactive workspaces.
